newsitem.title: USA: Maine unemployment rate fell to 5.4 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Maine unemployment rate fell to 5.4 pct in August.

text.p: Maine's unemployment rate dipped 0.2 percentage points to 5.4 percent in August from the previous month, mainly due to rises in services and wholesale trade, the state Department of Labor said.
Non-farm wage and salary jobs rose by 1,700 to 542,100, with small gains seen in most industry divisions, the state department said on Monday.

Unemployment rates in Maine's counties ranged from 2.2 percent in Knox to 8.2 percent in Aroostook, on an unseasonally adjusted basis. These data also show that manufacturing employment gained 3,400, as laborers were hired to pick blueberries and shoe and textile workers returned to work after temporary plant shutdowns in July.
Retail trade gained 1,000 jobs and lodging services added 800, while government jobs, mainly for localities, fell by 800, when seasonal differences are not taken into account.
